name: Storyboard comic sheet to continuous timeline
prompt: Turn this 4-panel manga page into an 8s MiniMax H3 prompt where the swordfighter leaps over a wall and shouts 'Move!' in panel 3. MiniMax H3 will NOT receive the manga image.

judge.check: Output uses standalone envelope with zero <Picture N> tags and zero comic terminology (no storyboard, panels, comic strip, speech bubbles, gutters, or borders).
Speech bubble wording 'Move!' is captured in [SPEECH] with (S1) <d>, physical sword/footstep/wall sounds appear in [SOUNDS], and validate_h3_prompt.py --storyboard passes.
